# WorldStepperState

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/`](../folders/src-view.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/world_stepper.h`](../../../src/view/world_stepper.h)

## Summary

Interpolation factor and pause state of the real-time world stepper.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by WorldStepperSys::preinit and rewritten each tick (when worlds exist). alpha in [0, 1) is where the frame sits between the last two fixed ticks (1 when paused); WorldViewSys, SphereViewSys and RollerPlayerSys use it to interpolate PhysicsPose. paused/step_once are toggled by the stepper's own ImGui panel. Readers fall back to alpha = 1 when it is absent.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | `double` | 1. | accumulator / h after stepping, or 1 when paused. |
| `h` | `double` | 1. / 60. | World 0's WorldClock::dt, refreshed each tick. |
| `paused` | `bool` | false | Panel checkbox; no real-time ticks while set. |
| `step_once` | `bool` | false | Panel Step button: pauses and runs exactly one tick on the next frame. |
| `ticks` | `uint64_t` | 0 | Total ticks stepped by the stepper. |
